Wedding films
Player comparison

Compare the existing popup player with an inline player. Neither loads a video provider until you choose to play or load that provider.

Francesca & Chris at Gargiulo’s

Existing click to open player

Inline player

Loading this player connects your browser to Vimeo. The provider receives technical information and may use cookies. This choice is separate from optional GioLina analytics and is not saved.

The Vimeo test uses its Do Not Track parameter. Vimeo says essential player/security cookies can still be used.

No inline provider loaded.

Jazz & Trevor at Boscobel

Existing click to open player

Inline player

Loading this player connects your browser to MediaZilla. The provider receives technical information and may use cookies. This choice is separate from optional GioLina analytics and is not saved.

No inline provider loaded.

Discovery and privacy

The inline iframe is visible after permission, without a popup. Before that choice, there is no provider iframe for Google to discover. This version preserves the current request boundary; it does not solve automatic video discovery. Immediate embedding requires a separate provider cookie and privacy decision before production use.

Removing a player stops this page from keeping its iframe loaded. It cannot erase information or cookies already processed by the provider.
